title: Somewhere not to be missed.
text: Ayman our representative was great.  He was extremely informative and had a relaxing attitude.  The tour of the olive vineyard was also informative and relaxing.  The owners spoke good English, were welcoming and offered samples of their olive oil which was truly tasty and first class.  We would definitely visit again when next in the area.
author: X645UBmaryb

title: Wonderful
text: Insightful, and well rounded experience. We enjoyed it very much. We feel we will take our new found knowledge and apply it in our life.
author: Adriana_L

title: Best tour of our honeymoon
text:
Top quality experience. Miguel was our driver - he was very professional and delivered us smoothly and safely to the farm.

On the farm, Elena was our tour guide and she was amazing. Knowledgeable, gave a great tour, and was excellent company. There were only four of us total on the tour, so we had plenty of opportunity to ask questions and Elena had answers for them all.

Would absolutely recommend this tour, 10/10, and would also recommend buying lots of oil from the gift shop.
author: Thomas_F

title: It was wonderful! Learned...
text: It was wonderful! Learned a lot about olive growing. There were only 4 people on the tour and that made it so special.
author: Barbara_M

title: Excellent and informative olive oil farm tour
text: We originally had a private tour booked, but it had to be rearranged.  They were very accommodating in offering alternatives.  The van driver was friendly and shared many tips and stories.  Our tour guide st the olive oil farm was excellent.  She shared so much information and we learned so much.  We loved the olive oil tasting and the sweet surprise!  Got to meet Juan, the owner of the farm.  Lovely way to spend 4 hours.  Do not hesitate to book.
author: dianekR67KH

title: Excellent olive farm and oil tasting tour
text: We did a wonderful olive farm and oil tasting half day tour with Naturanda. Very informative, interesting and well organised. Would highly recommend!
author: 90francesn

title: Excellent informative tour!
text: What a great experience! I learned so much on this tour.  The owner is very passionate about his farm,  and it was so interesting to see the old and new ways that olive oil is pressed.  We had a tasting,  and wow what a difference quality makes!  So glad we took this tour.  Highly recommend!
author: Laura N

title: Great visit!
text: Really interesting, informative, friendly And helpful driver and guide at the farm. Really fun, interactive experience. I learned a lot about olive oil!
author: Michael_S

text: The tour was wonderful! Our guide (Angela) was very friendly and very knowledgeable about the farm and olives. We also met the owner of the farm who was very friendly and great to talk to!

title: Great experience
